message.content:
Based on the search results, here's how to log into OneDrive:

## Web Browser (OneDrive Web Version)

**Method 1: Direct Login**
1. Open your web browser and go to **https://onedrive.live.com/login/**
2. Click the "Sign in" button in the top right corner
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email address** or phone number
4. Click **Next**
5. Enter your **password**
6. Click **Sign in**

**Method 2: Via Microsoft 365 Portal**
1. Go to **https://portal.office.com** or **https://m365.cloud.microsoft**
2. Sign in with your Microsoft account credentials
3. Search for "OneDrive" and click on the OneDrive app

## Windows Desktop App

1. Click the **Start** menu and search for "OneDrive"
2. Click on the **OneDrive app** to open it
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email** when prompted
4. Click **Sign in**
5. Enter your **password**
6. Follow any additional prompts to complete setup

## Mobile Device

1. Download and install the **OneDrive app** from your device's app store (iOS/Android)
2. Tap on the OneDrive app to open it
3. Sign in with your **Microsoft account** credentials

## Important Notes

- You need a **Microsoft account** to log into OneDrive. If you don't have one, you can create one at the login page by clicking "Create one" or "Use your phone number instead"
- If you have **two-factor authentication (2FA)** enabled, you'll need to verify your identity after entering your password
- If you forgot your password, click the **"Forgot password"** link to reset it
- For work or school accounts, use your organization credentials (e.g., username@yourorganization.edu)

Sources:
1. https://www.bunian.cn/22394.html
2. https://td.usnh.edu/TDClient/60/Portal/KB/Article/2064/OneDrive-Accessing-Logging-in-to-OneDrive
3. https://zhidao.baidu.com/question/931669486309366379.html
4. https://www.systoolsgroup.com/updates/copy-onedrive-files-to-another-onedrive-account/
5. https://www.cu.edu/doc/how-log-onedrive-pcpdf-3
6. https://www.reco.ai/hub/configure-onedrive-secure-file-access-login
7. https://inclowdz.wondershare.com/cloud-manage/switch-onedrive-account.html
8. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
